_readme: Numbers eval/report.py cannot derive from an eval run, kept here so the
committed report stays reproducible and every value is reviewable in a diff.
p95_latency: CLAUDE.md §7 asks for end-to-end latency. An eval run measures
one pipeline step against ground truth, so the only place the whole chain is
docker exec claims-cockpit-db-1 psql -U claims -d claims_cockpit -c "
WHERE raw_message_id IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*), percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms)
Summed per message, not taken from created_at: the audit rows of one message
all carry the transaction's opening timestamp, so a max-minus-min over them
measures zero. duration_ms is the only per-step timing that is real.
provenance: measurement dates for result files that carry no meta block of
their own. Set when the file was produced; eval/report.py reads it so those
rows are dated like every other row.

p95_latency.sample_description: pipeline'dan geçmiş ihbarlar (denetim izi olan tüm kayıtlar)
notes: Mesaj başına adım sürelerinin toplamı üzerinden; medyan 4,92 sn.
Kapsam, denetim izi bulunan kayıtlar. Veritabanındaki ilk 57 ihbar seed betiğiyle doğrudan yazıldığı için pipeline'dan hiç geçmemiştir ve bu ölçümün dışındadır.
